build_fastspeech2_model: build a FastSpeech2 text-to-speech model using fairseq with encoder and decoder FFT layers
create_variance_predictor: create a VariancePredictor module with conv layers to predict duration, pitch, or energy
create_variance_adaptor: create a VarianceAdaptor module that predicts durations, pitch, and energy then applies length regulation
create_fft_layer: create an FFTLayer module with multi-head self-attention and position-wise feed-forward for encoder or decoder
create_length_regulator: create a LengthRegulator module that expands phoneme sequences by predicted durations for TTS
